assumptions_for_human_review: S1 (design section 1): the entire additive schema, enums, ordering and snapshot/error policies in sections 4-8 are proposed API decisions, not Telegram or owner contracts; coverage follows the PRD proposed scope (eight media types + MessagePaidMedia).

S2 (section 4): exact proto names/numbers for ListMessageFiles RPC and new messages/enums; verified collision-free against the 17 baseline symbols in internal/transport/grpc/pb/facade.proto and syntactically valid (scratch libprotoc 34.2 check recorded in review/draft-validation.md).

S3 (section 5): grouping (one item per media, one item per paid slot), duplicate-ID occurrence identity (item_index, role, source_index), HLS/alternative pairing by equal source_index, and default_file_id taken from the unchanged resolveMessageFile.

S4 (section 5): metadata policy - size only from File.Size>0, no ExpectedSize inference, photo-size MIME fixed to image/jpeg (matches baseline resolver), thumbnail/alternative/premium fields left empty rather than guessed.

S5 (section 7): app contract - exactly one telegramRepo.GetMessage call, ctx.Err checked before/after/return, nil message maps to existing NewMessageNotFoundError, no new repository method or SDK call.

S6 (section 7): per-handler InvalidArgument validation (nonzero chat, positive message, as GetMessageFile) and per-handler Canceled/DeadlineExceeded mapping on top of the unchanged mapFacadeError; global mapper untouched.
S7 (section 8): no MIME context transfer into DownloadFile; default_file_id=0 means no GetMessageFile default; new client vs old image gets Unimplemented with no lossy fallback.

PRD proposed-scope defaults (explicitly marked [ASSUMPTION] in prd.md): which paid slots are listed without purchase, inclusion of file-backed thumbnails/covers and regular-sticker premium animation, exclusion of minithumbnail bytes and nested media.
